rules.success: DB success (db_match with a user_stop/agent_stop ending)
rules.runaway: no normal ending: context-window overflow (W10), 200-step cap (max_steps) or loop-guard stop (W73, W2 panel only)
rules.tool_errors: tau2 stopped the episode after 10 failed tool executions (too_many_errors)
rules.parse_end: episode ended by an unparseable agent output (infra cause agent_parse_error / agent_empty_output; W27, W41)
rules.format: normal ending; a required write was never issued as a parsed tool call, and the agent wrote >= 1 tool call as plain text (JSON without the <tool_call> markup) or as markup the parser rejected
rules.no_write: normal ending; a write was required and the agent attempted none, in any form (stopped, asked, refused or transferred)
rules.wrong_tool: normal ending; the set of write tools the agent called differs from the required set (incl. writes when none was required)
rules.wrong_args: normal ending; same write-tool set as required, end state still wrong (arguments, count or failed calls)
rules.other: normal ending, DB mismatch, none of the above
